column6: Say to my lord: this is what @wPN{Aradŋu}, your servant, says:
@wPN{Aba-indasa}, the captain of the royal pledged troops, has sent you ……. May my lord take note most carefully concerning this matter.

When I had set my sights towards @wGN{Zimudar}, I was levying troops for the expedition, my lord; but when @wPN{Aba-indasa} had inspected the troops, 2000 men of those troops were missing. They were not ……, nor ……. They have …… the fortress, my lord, they have taken …….
…… offence ……. @gap{2 lines fragmentary} Whatever you say, my lord! May my lord know!
